theme_label_cn: 紫藤主题 · 箫 · 幻蝶灵境·守梦人
age_phrase: a slender young woman, likely in {p} late teens
gradient: pale lilac at the top to a deeper violet lower down
moon_halo: a hazy full moon ringed by a violet halo
backdrop: silhouetted mountain ridges and a small tiered Chinese pavilion standing behind the figure
hair_ornaments: small wisteria sprigs and silver butterfly pins

expr_desc_3: {p} head tips a little back, {p} lids sit low and glossy, {p} lips part loosely and colour rises on both cheeks

profile: 性格：慵懒散漫，清醒护短
喜好：酿紫藤花酒、收集众生梦境、雨中吹箫
couplet: 我本无心，只因你入梦，便留了心。
weapon_drawing: a small drawing of the white jade flute
background_text: 紫嫣，幻蝶灵境的守梦人。{T}以箫声引蝶，以梦为舟，渡人入梦，却从不入他人的梦。看似慵懒散漫、游戏人间，实则清醒孤绝，只肯在月下独酌。{T}在灵境中种满紫藤，引万千幻蝶为伴，唯独等一个从不做梦的人。箫声起时，紫蝶覆月；箫声落处，梦醒无痕。
signature: —— 一箫一蝶一浮生，梦里不知身是客。
lighting: the violet moon behind thin cloud
palette: pale lilac, wisteria violet and moon white
